evals.name: streaks-gamification
evals.prompt: Read .claude/agents/customer-voice.md then review the PRD at content/03-prds/streaks-2/streaks-2.md from a customer's perspective.
evals.expected_output: Structured customer review with all 6 personas, weighted verdict, Peloton Parity rule triggered for Guided Explorer, Onboarding Tax applied for Busy Optimizer

assertions.name: all_6_personas_present
assertions.description: Output includes reactions for all 6 personas: Power Tracker (Arthur), Busy Optimizer (Teresa), Guided Explorer (Marilyn), Tech-Savvy Engager (Chris), Self-Directed Builder (Supriya), Recovery Seeker (Almond)

assertions.name: correct_weight_ordering
assertions.description: Personas listed in descending weight order: 42%, 20%, 17%, 11%, 6%, 4%

assertions.name: weighted_verdict_present
assertions.description: Contains positive weight %, blocked weight %, and a verdict (Ship/Iterate/Rethink/Kill/Deprioritize)

assertions.name: rule_checks_complete
assertions.description: All 7 rule checks present: Silent Persona, Peloton Parity, NPS Detractor, Onboarding Tax, Quote or Flag, Cannibalization, Mid-Workout Disruption

assertions.name: feature_type_classification
assertions.description: Feature classified as Engagement, Retention, or Growth

assertions.name: impact_assessment_header
assertions.description: Includes Impact Assessment with personas served, weighted coverage %, primary beneficiary

assertions.name: interview_data_referenced
assertions.description: At least 2 persona reactions reference real interview quotes or behavioral data, or flag assumptions with the warning emoji
assertions.notes: Check that quotes reference real cluster members (Arthur, Teresa, Marilyn, Chris, Supriya, Almond, etc.) or flag with warning

assertions.name: impact_labels_present
assertions.description: Each persona reaction has an Impact label: BLOCKER, STRONG POSITIVE, NEUTRAL, or MILD CONCERN
